earlyGrantContract.idempotence: The same committed result and component slot applies its grant once; retries do not duplicate an ability, weapon, or Strength bonus.
earlyGrantContract.masteryTiming: Before the normal stages defer all weapon mastery and the single shared Power Mastery. Weapon instances retain their own normal mastery; all power grants share the character mastery record.
earlyGrantContract.mainWheelPolicy: Main weapon and power spins remain. A None result adds nothing and does not delete an earlier grant.
earlyGrantContract.powerGate: Finish main Power acquisition, immediate acquisition events/details and all authorized bonus acquisitions. Check the entire owned power inventory, including racial grants.
earlyGrantContract.weaponGate: At weapon stage, resolve all pending owned weapon masteries including early Trishula even if the main weapon draw adds no weapon.
earlyGrantContract.lateGrant: A late weapon resolves its own authorized mastery/enchantment subflow. A late power inherits shared mastery; if there has never been a mastery spin and the scheduled stage was empty, the first late power opens the one shared draw. Restore the saved caller.
earlyGrantContract.duplicateDefinitionPolicy: Existing instance/provenance rules apply; exact repeated-definition merge or exclusion policy remains pending. Never reroll a committed duplicate result.

strengthBonus.timing: Record the modifier at the race result. Add once to the later rolled base numeric Strength; do not modify or reroll the base result.
strengthBonus.scaleRequirement: Strength needs a numeric value scale or an explicitly declared tier-to-numeric mapping. +1 is not one ordinal tier.

contextContract.coverage: Elf family, all eight type results, all 36 ranked power results, both sea-form results, and all four season results carry context.
contextContract.timing: Apply only the committed result effects, append its factual context, then react using the as-of-result snapshot.
contextContract.fixedGrants: Fixed grants attach context to the type reveal; do not manufacture a separate random wheel or mastery spin at race stage.
contextContract.scope: Traits and powers below describe this game. Research identity themes do not add undeclared racial bonuses.

content/archetype-eligibility-design.jso.status: User-accepted Archetype eligibility policy; pure decision function implemented. Profiles explicitly required where design is incomplete.

authority.confirmedIntent: User asks Archetype to boost races/subraces without an upper hand and avoid incompatible combinations such as Dragon Alchemist and Mecha Vessel.

evaluationContract.timing: After the whole outer Race tree, both Hybrid roots and all attachment/origin/takeover events return; before main Archetype. Evaluate character once.
inputs: committed normalized Race tree results representing source-owned race packages, commanded army/victims/takeover and known future-stage tickets
approved final body capability profile; approved scoped composition assessment where required
forbiddenInputs: vampire prey identity as personal lineage
evaluationContract.stageTicketPolicy: Recognize committed tickets as opportunities with unknown results, never assume guaranteed power or use None from the future.
evaluationContract.result: candidate/skip/needs_configuration from evaluateArchetypeNeed; spin/skip/needs_configuration from planArchetypeStage. Required facts missing or invalid raise ArchetypeInputError; no random draw or state mutation.
evaluationContract.skipBehavior: Zero Archetype spins; journal explicit skip and continue Backstory. No NPC/None fake spin, role reward, or Shrek trigger. Raksasa has zero primary/secondary spins in policy 1.0.0.
evaluationContract.missingProfile: Missing approved body, role/event or composition source bindings yields needs_configuration. Siluman requires one selected animal from12, no count/sampling profile. A complete valid role pool with no compatible outcomes skips; invalid required facts or non-positive enabled weights raise an input error.
evaluationContract.filter: Validate approved role event/requirements and final body profile; filter incompatible roles before normalization. Default weight 1; explicit configured positive weights preserved. Valid complete pool with no compatible role skips; missing pool/profile yields needs_configuration.
evaluationContract.limits: No universal power=2/stat=1 eligibility score is adopted. Mythical/Hero comparison budgets remain local design metadata. Potency order is not the later Power Mastery rank.
evaluationContract.idempotence: Commit the plan snapshot once through commitArchetypePlan, atomically with future scheduling. Resume reuses that plan and invocation ID, even after configuration changes. Actual seeded spin/reaction/ledger remain the future engine responsibility.
evaluationContract.inputBoundary: Fixed grants and race-local modifiers are represented by the approved selected subtype/event outcomes. The gate does not inspect or execute the inventory/effect ledger; completed nodes are an engine assertion that Race events have finished.

compositionRules.rule: Resolve both roots and all descendants first. A strong granted package makes the combined character skip. A standalone skip due solely to body fit must be re-evaluated against the explicitly defined combined body; never automatically infer humanoid fusion or let one component name alone deny/enable every role. Two light roots still need aggregate and body review. No per-root Archetype.
examples: Human + Goblin Kacung → candidate spin once
Human + Elf with light Holy → aggregate/body review, not automatic double reward
Symbiote → Raksasa → Abyssal plus second Hybrid root → final aggregate skip under accepted policy
Human + Household → actual composite body review; standalone Household skip does not erase Human/other-source grants or invent a humanoid appliance.

compositionRules.rule: Use the full origin tree and normal origin rewards, then undead body requirements; Human origin can be eligible, Dragon origin remains skip. The Lelembut origin label adds no automatic stat/power upper hand.
Evaluate actual host and takeover together; a skipped/strong host is never requalified by 0% takeover. Low takeover does not create an extra role slot.
All Raksasa components skip from the committed giant binding, without seeing future Size/Cosmic. Policy 1.0.0 creates no primary or secondary Archetype and no deferred Archetype ticket.
Prey race is feeding reference only; never runs prey race eligibility/events or changes character family history.

Exactly one animal spin from twelve approved types, equal base weights (1/12 before modifiers). No count wheel or additional type spin. Normal form humanoid with animal traits, one common transformation bound to that result. No automatic bonus from names; explicit body/role profiles remain required.

Household skip preserves deliberately weak own function, not removal of bonuses from a Hybrid/host/other source. Shrek Growth already committed from real tagged spins remains; no fake skip spin triggers it.

incompatible / subtype skips under accepted policy 1.0.0

candidateFits: Android Print Struk → Survivalist atau Trickster jika requirements cocok
compatibilityExamples.boundary: Fits are illustrations only. No role event, stat, mastery, organic body, ritual capacity, summoning, or special tool is granted from the role name. Full per-role requirements/reward profiles are still pending for the observed video roster.

contracts.order: Actual Slayer result/reaction -> target Race reference -> relevant identity selectors -> complete victim identity -> one ten-outcome count spin/reaction -> source-scoped Strength modifier -> Backstory.
contracts.referenceOnly: Victim identity is separate from the character. No victim race events, fixed grants, weapons, powers, mastery, army/follower counts, Size, Takeover, stats, titles or loot are executed/copied. Cosmic group reference never follows armor/ring/color reward wheels.
contracts.history: Use an independent usedVictimFamilyIds set across the victim tree. Target references do not consume/clear the character usedRaceFamilyIds. Target wrappers exclude already selected victim families before child draws; empty required pool is a configuration error.
contracts.probability: Target selectors keep canonical option weights/fixed ratios. Only the new Slayer count wheel uses delegated custom fixed likelihood profiles; canonical Vampire six-count odds remain unchanged. New count profiles have a 5% floor per outcome after normalization, total 100%; never clamp then renormalize below the floor. This count-only policy does not rebalance canonical identity selectors. Existing committed 1.0.0 count snapshots retain their original results/odds.
contracts.profileSelection: Difficulty is authored encounter-frequency metadata, never a main-stat score, power feat or lore guarantee. Last applicable subtype selects its profile; Siluman uses the single selected animal type. Anime NPC uses common regardless of genre; MC uses genre then Sci-fi identity role, without genre events.
contracts.composition: Skeleton/Zombie use their origin profile with minimum common; Symbiote uses host with minimum elite and no Takeover; Raksasa uses base +1 difficulty step with minimum apex, without Size; Hybrid uses hardest component +1 step. Cap at divine. One victim is the whole composite, not a count per component.
contracts.strength: Zero gives no modifier. Positive positions 1–3 +1, 4–6 +2, 7–9 +3 numeric Strength. Cap Slayer reward at +3; do not copy Vampire all-stat/Cursed rewards or infer extra loot from God/hero victims.
contracts.ledger: Register one flat Strength effect keyed by committed count spin/source. Project after immutable base Strength without numeric clamps; resume/re-render restores result/effect without redispatch, resampling or duplicate boost.
contracts.reaction: Each actual target/identity/count spin has its own reaction. Early beats reveal only committed target facts; reward known after count. Fixed bonus is not an extra spin or funny-result tag.

runtime.sizeInput: Frozen Size plan and its recorded draw with matching owner identity. No transformation Size.
runtime.freeze: Identity/source IDs, selected hidden profiles, model, role/event likelihoods, Size/reference/shift, inventory, hard guards, prior, posterior and minimum/maximum bounds and bounded odds saved before external RNG. Fixed plans preserve guarantee/source, base9 and no sampled attempts; replay original saved resolution mode.
runtime.replay: Resolve saved plans without recomputing current parameters. Caller persists plans/draws and consumes source keys atomically.
pending: Final Enchant queues and aggregate Lucky Number/Pawn settlement.

content/stat-odds-design.json.unmodeledContextPolicy: Record unmatched event sources without guessing numeric effects. Explicit likelihoods can be added; plain narrator text, victim/army identities, follower counts, final bonus ledgers and power-tier metadata are not automatically converted to parameters.

probabilityBounds.scope: Only eligible actual raw stat/mastery outcomes, including each Resilient attempt.
probabilityBounds.algorithm: p(i)=minimum+min(lambda*weight(i),maximum-minimum); solve shared lambda in log space so total=1, preserving free-sector excess odds ratios above the floor.
probabilityBounds.feasibility: N*minimum<=1<=N*maximum; hard-excluded outcomes never receive the floor.
probabilityBounds.history: God original template stays an unbounded prior; every new final wheel uses the new bounds. Saved previous plans retain frozen probabilities.

maximumGuaranteeContract.scope: Actual committed maximum guarantees for stats or mastery skip the random wheel.
maximumGuaranteeContract.God: Actual God subtype fixes the one shared Power Mastery base9 for all owned present/future powers, including Authority, Divine and ordinary grants.
maximumGuaranteeContract.VesselGod: God patron at compatibility60/70/80/90/100 inherits the existing maximum guarantee; all owned Power Mastery base9. Lower bands and demon patron do not qualify.
maximumGuaranteeContract.Lich: Committed Lich fixes Durability base9; no singleton100% spin in new runs.

contracts.ownership: Exclude already-owned canonical definition+ordinary grant mode before every actual draw; preserve earlier powers after None. Fixed identical grants merge source provenance; Authority mode/bounded bindings stay distinct.
contracts.general: Main then approved sequential extras. Extra tickets freeze at actual Power stage and are consumed once; Mage ordinary2/master3 total, not additional to the main count.
contracts.theme: Eight canonical thematic wheels remain separate/equal and get one actual grant per invocation; no merged mega-pool or normal God None.
contracts.mastery: After all acquisitions, one shared Power Mastery gate. Empty inventory skips; God/full/partial-qualified Vessel max9 skips RNG; ordinary completed shared base reused for late grants. No Power Enchant.
contracts.exhaustion: needs_configuration when no eligible real power remains; preserve state. Never reroll, grant duplicates, silently drop a guaranteed spin or replace thematic wheel with main pool.
contracts.probability: Stat/mastery5%..25% bounds and weapon equal-tier reservation do not apply. Equalizer flattens all eligible leaves including None after hard guarantees/ownership. Master Sihir exact x3 applied after base lore weights, only Mage-managed acquisitions.
contracts.scope: Only selected canonical ordinary power, never source race/archetype/reward/stat/weapon package or Authority override. Tier independent of mastery.
contracts.freeze: Freeze source context, ownership snapshot, positive eligible leaves, canonical recipes/tiers and probability trace before external RNG; preserve frozen history.
contracts.mutation: Caller atomically stores result/grant/consumed ticket and source ledger; pure helper emits receipts and continuations.

content/weapon-wheel-design.json.status: User delegates150 weapons and conditional acquisition odds. Roster/tiers/tags/default probabilities are editable authored game design; pure odds/result helpers, persistent executor/compatibility adapters remain future.

authority.count: About150; exactly150 weapon entries plus one None sector.
authority.conditional: Race, Backstory and Archetype affect each invocation; Paladin Sacred Sword approximately10%; Dragon more likely None.
authority.preserve: Stat/mastery 5%..25% bounds do not apply to150 weapon outcomes; general Power timing, existing grants/mastery/Gladiator lock unchanged.
authority.tierProbability: Latest user: for weapon since it is a lot, lets make probability for each tier equal.
authority.latestAffinity: Audit all current owner subtypes for weapon reliance; gentle matching preferences including Knight swords. Brass Knuckle and Nunchaku remain Tier3.

wheel.layout: One flat acquisition wheel, no separate Tier spin. Sort None then Tier1..5 along anticlockwise sampling order. Equalizer operates on individual eligible sectors.

contracts.freeze: Only actual committed owner Race/Archetype/Backstory facts; freeze eligible IDs, full recipes, weights, trace and source keys before RNG. No future facts, enemies, companions, army, narration or final numeric bonuses as likelihood evidence.
contracts.hardGuards: Gladiator committed lock skips acquisition before RNG. Apply explicit item exclusions/None exclusion for guaranteed extras before soft lore; an empty eligible pool needs_configuration. No inferred anatomical weapon bans.
contracts.none: Main None grants nothing and removes nothing. Early weapons still get scheduled mastery; species None percentages are editable acquisition propensities, not permanent inability.
contracts.extra: Guaranteed Orc Warrior/etc bonus requires count/type ticket from existing caller and excludes None; helper never invents an extra spin. Freeze again after each actual acquisition.
contracts.mastery: One normal resolution per active owned instance. Weapon Tier1..5 never sets/boosts/gates mastery0..9. Bonuses calculate final-only; Enchant uses final effective mastery and actual compatible definition.
contracts.canon: Named signatures are game adaptations. Receiving an item dispatches no race/hero/archetype/power events or automatic extra abilities; no inherited donor mastery, full character kit, instant stats or preset Enchant.
contracts.duplicates: Different weapon grant sources create distinct instances. No new no-repeat weapon rule; preserve all existing journals and caller-specific uniqueness policies.
contracts.funny: Only authored funny-result outcomes may signal an actual funny spin for existing source-once Shrek hook; None and fixed grants do not become fake funny rolls.
contracts.equalizer: After hard eligibility, every remaining sector including None has equal probability. Overrides lore/tier rarity, species None propensity and Paladin10% anchor; no reweight afterward.
contracts.equalTier: Preserve equal20% per Tier conditional on getting a weapon. Normalize each tier separately after lore and within-tier anchors. All five tiers require at least one eligible weapon; a completely excluded tier needs_configuration.
contracts.affinity: Ordinary soft preferences1..1.6 per source, at most2 combined item weight within each tier. Tagged sword is distinct from dagger/axe. Explicit Paladin reservation retains the earlier about10% target.
contracts.wrappers: Physical host/base/origin priors compose once. Select one most-specific behavioral overlay per actual wrapper source. No prey/army/companion/mentor/external mecha or full-animal transformation becomes owner weapon evidence.
contracts.history: New plans use0.2; saved0.1 plans replay their frozen weights/recipes without recalculation.

contracts.identity: One explicit rating per exact definitionId+definitionFile; aliases/repeated grants inherit it. Canonical definition metadata and registry must match; no caption-derived rating.
contracts.mastery: Tier measures intrinsic capability; mastery measures proficiency and cannot increase tier. Existing Concept power/authority scopes may have separate mode ratings, independent of source-bound God maximum rank.
contracts.capacity: Tier grants no automatic area/damage/immunity/victory/new effect; existing scope and configured limitations still apply.
contracts.probability: No automatic tier rarity/reweighting. Only the separately expanded Alchemist working draft changes odds; other wheels remain unchanged.
contracts.balance: Rating metadata is not main stat or automatic budget conversion. Preserve explicit grants/bonuses and existing power=2-point reward budgets until a separately approved tier-to-budget rule.
contracts.household: All twenty ordinary Household functions stay tier 1 with ordinary household capacity, regardless of Size or mastery.
contracts.journal: Freeze tierPolicyVersion/reference/grantMode/rating for newly owned power. Old outcomes/effects remain frozen; unlabelled old powers need versioned annotation, never newest-catalog mechanical upgrade.
contracts.missing: Unknown definition/file or undeclared grant mode returns needs_configuration; no default tier or AI guessing.
contracts.acquisition: Alchemy elixirs grant fixed linked owned powers under normal shared mastery, None retention, no mastery-triggered Enchant.
contracts.retiredDefinitionAcquisition: Retired definitions retain exact lookup/old-journal ratings but activeForNewAcquisition:false excludes new rewards/catalog generation; no silent alias promotion.

runtimeInterface.purpose: Explicit metadata lookup only; no spins/grants/combat/odds mutations.

confirmedRules: Lelembut -> Lokal/Impor -> corresponding creature type.

Garuda and Barong belong under Mythical Beast.
Use familiar mixed Indonesian/English names rather than strict translation.
Siluman can roll multiple animal types.

Keep Hybrid as a standalone race-wheel option with its own event.

Human has no race event: ordinary human, nothing special; after the complete outer Race chain evaluate the Archetype gate.
Accumulate stacked character context for autonomous AI reactions as results and approved traits are committed.
All eight Elf types are confirmed: High, Dark, Forest, Sea, Blood, Fey, Shadow, and Astral Elf.
High Elf spins one of 12 Holy Powers; Dark Elf one of 12 Cursed Powers; Blood Elf one of 12 vampire-themed Blood Powers. The assistant defines ascending potential lists.
Forest Elf gains Forest Control; Shadow Elf gains Shadow Manipulation; Astral Elf gains Astral Projection.
Sea Elf spins Putri Duyung 60% with Mermaid Song or Atlantean Warrior 40% with +1 numeric Strength point and Trishula.
Fey Elf spins Summer/Fire, Autumn/Decay, Winter/Ice, or Spring/Life and receives the corresponding power.
Early added powers count as owned powers at the later mastery gate; a None main Power result does not remove them.
Every Elf type and follow-up outcome adds factual stacked narration context.
Kurcaci spins Dwarf or Gnome; Dwarf receives armor events and Gnome receives one technology weapon.
Dwarf spins an armor count from 1 to 5, then performs exactly that many armor-piece spins without replacement.
Dwarf armor pieces are Helmet, Gloves, Body Armor, Leggings, and Boots. Disable chosen sections before subsequent draws; never award the same piece twice in that armor event.
Helmet, Body Armor, and Leggings each add +1 Durability; Gloves add +1 Fight; Boots add +1 Speed, recorded as numeric-point modifiers under the existing point convention.
Gnome spins one tech from a delegated approximately-20-item pool; the selected tech counts as an owned weapon for later Weapon Mastery.
Use a Gnome-aligned gadget pool based on tinkering, clockwork, springs, traps, lenses, alchemy, and decoys rather than the previous generic technology weapon pool.
Goblin spins army count 0/5/20/100/1000/10000 with weights 5:10:15:10:5:1, then Bos/Kacung with 1:1 regardless of count.
Orc roles have weights Orc General:Oni:Orc Warrior:Shaman:Shrek = 1:2:3:3:1. General spins army count; Oni spins Cursed Power and gains Katana.
Orc Warrior gets an extra weapon spin; Shaman gets an extra Power spin later.
Shrek receives a Shrek Power profile and +1 numeric point to all five stats for every subsequent funny spin result, as clarified by the user.
Troll spins one of twelve disease/condition outcomes; each decreases a mapped main stat. Asma is -1 Speed and Penyakit Kulit is -1 Durability.
Raksasa skips Archetype under user-accepted policy 1.0.0, superseding both former slots. Base-race events and giant Size/Cosmic remain.
All characters spin Size after Backstory events and before the five main stats. Raksasa uses 10 m, 50 m, 100 m, 1 km, 10 km, 100 km, Planet Size, Sun Size.
A committed size strictly larger than Planet Size opens one universal Cosmic Power spin with twelve delegated cosmic choices.
Ordinary Size uses source-informed usual size and twelve sections spanning 0.5 to 2 times that reference, with a broad normal-shaped probability distribution. Giant Size uses logarithmic magnitudes.
Holy, Cursed, Blood, Cosmic, and future thematic Power wheels each have one universal canonical pool; every eligible caller uses that same wheel.
Peri selects Fairy Parents/Element Pixie/Healer Fairy/Fairy King with fixed weights 4:2:3:1.
Fairy Parents receives Wish Granting; Element Pixie spins the universal Element selector and gains that element manipulation power; Healer Fairy receives Healing Power.
Fairy King gets one extra Power spin and +2 Power Mastery for all owned powers, as clarified by the user.
Use animals associated with keramat and folklore, especially Indonesia, for Siluman; user examples include Harimau, Serigala, Babi, and Ayam.
The user accepts all ten Siluman animals and grants one Animal Transformation power for the animals obtained from its spins; detailed mastery and balance remain unresolved.
Lelembut keeps twelve local types and only six imported types: Skeleton, Vampire, Zombie, Lich, Ghost and Mummy; Ghoul and the remaining imported candidates are removed from the active pool.

Local Lelembut grants: Pocong Jump; Tuyul Nyolong; Kuntilanak Flight; Genderuwo Size Manipulation; Wewe Gombel Child Protection; Sundel Bolong Mukbang; Kuyang Flight and Organ Control; Leak one universal Cursed Power spin; Palasik Head Detachment; Banaspati shared Fire Manipulation; Jenglot Pesugihan; Suster Ngesot Ngesot and -1 numeric Speed.

Vampire spins race as its prey preference, then victim count 0/1/5/10/100/1000 with disclosed weights 5:4:3:3:2:1. Counts 100 and 1000 each give +1 numeric point to all five stats; 1000 also draws one universal Cursed Power.
Lich queues one extra normal Power spin and guarantees maximum Durability; constraining the scheduled base Durability result is the current design interpretation.
Ghost grants Intangibility, explicitly clarified by the user; Mummy grants Sand Manipulation.
Babi Ngepet receives Nyolong; routing this through Siluman Babi keeps the accepted animal structure. Tuyul and Babi use one shared power definition.
Skeleton and Zombie spin the canonical race wheel for Ras asal and run the selected source family approved events while retaining the undead identity.
All character-identity race respins disable every previously committed race family and normalize eligible remaining weights before drawing; use shared character history across origin/parent branches.

Golem spins seven types: Sand/Rock/Magma/Crystal/Diamond/Element/Trash. Every type grants manipulation for its material or selected element; Element Golem invokes the one canonical Element wheel once.

The canonical power wheel has twelve delegated powers; odds remain pending.

Demigod spins the same Concept as an ordinary power without fixed-max mastery and gains +1 numeric point on all five main stats. Angel spins Angelic Power twice.
Utusan Tuhan spins the same Concept as an ordinary power and adds +1 shared Power Mastery. Pemuka Agama spins Divine Power once. Orang Saleh gains Komunikasi dengan Tuhan.
Divine, Cursed, Demonic and Angelic have twenty equal outcomes each, sorted Tier 1–5 with four per tier. Holy remains twelve; common canonical powers are reused by reference.
All wheels use equal base probability unless the user specifies a distribution, including earlier race designs; preserve declared eligibility and conditional modifiers.

eventPolicy.behavior: Spin/react to Dwarf or Gnome. Dwarf spins an armor count then exactly that many unique armor pieces; Gnome spins one technology weapon. Resolve each result and its context, then continue to archetype.

armorContract.requestedSpins: The committed armor-count result N requires exactly N actual armor-piece spins.
armorContract.scope: One Dwarf armor-award event, identified by runId, event invocation, and component slot when applicable.
armorContract.beforeEachDraw: Remove all chosen armor IDs from the eligible set, apply declared guards to remaining pieces, normalize remaining weights, and freeze this draw distribution.
armorContract.commit: Atomically journal the result, append the chosen ID, grant its armor instance and one +1 numeric modifier, update remaining IDs, append context, then react.
armorContract.repeatKey: Every scheduled draw has its own stable invocation ID and ordinal; do not share one consumed-event key across repeated draws.
armorContract.duplicatePolicy: Chosen pieces always have effective weight zero. Weight modifiers cannot restore their eligibility. Never reroll a committed duplicate or substitute another result.
armorContract.wheelRendering: Chosen sections are disabled and have zero sector angle in subsequent active wheels. Redistribute the active circle using remaining frozen probabilities; show collected pieces outside the active wheel if desired.
armorContract.lastDrawPolicy: If N=5, the fifth scheduled piece spin still occurs with the sole remaining piece at 100%, then receives its own result/reaction. This is an explicit exception to the generic fixed-identity reveal shortcut.

pieceWeights.status: User-confirmed equal probability default for eligible armor pieces; preserve specified armor-count weights.
pieceWeights.reason: Equal active-piece base odds follow the user default. Remove selected pieces before normalizing; change the base distribution only if the user specifies an override before a draw.

armorContract.poolExhaustion: Configuration error if requested remaining draws exceed eligible remaining unique pieces; do not truncate the awarded count or silently reuse a piece.
armorContract.bonusUnits: Numeric points, following the established +1-point convention; numeric scales or explicit mappings required.
armorContract.additionalStats: No unrequested material, quality, weight, durability, intelligence, or mobility effects are inferred.

gnomeTechContract.poolOrder: Catalog order only; no potency ranking requested.
gnomeTechContract.grant: Grant exactly one technology weapon instance from the selected result.
gnomeTechContract.mastery: Register unresolved Weapon Mastery and process it at the normal main Weapon stage, including when the main draw is None.
gnomeTechContract.existingGear: Keep the tech weapon alongside any later weapons; follow the shared owned-inventory and grant-provenance contract.
gnomeTechContract.powerBoundary: Effects produced by a technology weapon do not automatically grant a matching personal power.
gnomeTechContract.weights: User-confirmed equal base weights (1 per eligible option) unless the user specified a distribution; declared eligibility and conditional modifiers are applied before normalization.
gnomeTechContract.theme: Gnome tinker gadgets based on clockwork, steam, springs, traps, lenses, alchemy, and decoys.
gnomeTechContract.weaponClassification: Direct attacks, traps, control devices, and tactical decoys all count as weapons under the user rule. A construct gadget includes its operating mechanism/controller in one weapon kit; it does not spawn extra weapon or power grants.
gnomeTechContract.masteryMeaning: Precision, timing, targeting, placement, and operation/control of the chosen gadget; actual mastery rank remains a later spin.
gnomeTechContract.sourcePolicy: Official sources support the broad tinkering/clockwork and mechanized-gnome themes. These twenty gadgets and combat functions are original game adaptations, not a list of canonical racial equipment.

bonusSpinContract.register: A role result records a stage bonus ticket with its source invocation and component slot; register each once.
bonusSpinContract.sequence: At the target stage: main acquisition spin and its immediate details -> each pending bonus acquisition spin and details -> mastery for every owned instance still unresolved -> eligible weapon enchantment -> next main stage.
bonusSpinContract.eligibility: Freeze fresh odds at each bonus spin using current build/declared eligible pool. Do not carry a race-stage frozen weapon/power draw.
bonusSpinContract.idempotence: Consume the ticket when its bonus result commits; resuming cannot create a second spin or erase earlier grants.

warrior.emptyOutcomePolicy: Exclude None/no-weapon results before drawing because the user requests an extra weapon. Error if no eligible weapon remains.

shaman.emptyOutcomePolicy: The extra spin uses the normal Power outcome rules, including None if the approved pool allows it. The request guarantees a spin, not an extra power regardless of result.

bonusSpinContract.lateActivation: If a role ticket is acquired after its target stage, dispatch its acquisition/mastery subflow from the current caller and return; never restart the main sequence.

shrekContract.strongestProfile: Shrek is the intended strongest Orc-wheel profile through repeat five-stat growth. Actual final rolls and mastery remain independent.

hybridContract.eligibleFamilyPolicy: Use the complete canonical main race pool, including Reinkarnasi Pahlawan Legendaris, Anime and Heavenly Principle. Filter all previously selected families; Hybrid is already used when its event starts, so it cannot select itself.

Register later-stage tickets without advancing main stages. Only then spin component 2 using the accumulated history and run its events the same way.
hybridContract.distinctnessPolicy: Before every identity-family draw disable ALL previously committed families across both roots and every nested host/origin, not just the first root or final leaf. Filter before draw, never reroll forbidden results.
hybridContract.poolExhaustion: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
hybridContract.eventOrder: Hybrid result/reaction → component 1 result/reaction and complete immediate nested chain → component 2 result/reaction and complete immediate chain → record completion → saved caller. No fusion stability or dominance wheel.

hybridContract.journalPolicy: Two stable root slots 1/2, with separately linked host/origin descendants. Every invocation carries component/parent/root-slot and return continuation. History is shared globally.
hybridContract.effectsPolicy: Retain every explicitly approved grant, modifier, guarantee and deferred ticket from both actual chains. Apply each source once under source-once additive stacking with no numeric floor/cap. No blanket stat addition, halving, automatic power package, suppression or extra mastery spin.
hybridContract.anatomyPolicy: Store both root identities and nested modifiers in one body brief. Anatomical conflict/body-reference policy remains pending; do not invent stability/dominance results or discard committed race rewards.
hybridContract.returnTo: saved caller; archetype for ordinary main race-stage chain
hybridContract.size: One global Size spin. Any committed Raksasa component binds existing giant variant; otherwise use explicit sourced body/reference composition rules. Do not average unknown measurements.
hybridContract.mastery: All owned powers share the existing single character mastery and scoped Authority exception. Weapons keep their normal per-weapon mastery/Enchant.
hybridContract.context: Append actual roots, nested families, grants, modifiers and upcoming steps with provenance. Future second race and final stats remain unknown until committed.
hybridContract.idempotence: Keys include root slot and nested component/step. Resume restores a committed result and continues its unfinished children, never applies history to reroll it or executes an event twice.
hybridContract.budgets: Validate configured event budgets can support required chains. Current numerical limits are proposed; on required overflow fail configuration, never truncate the two-root sequence.

mechanicsContract.selectorInfluence: A family/origin result restricts the next eligible subtype pool. Subtypes and their events must additionally define their influences on future relevant wheels before simulation is enabled.
mechanicsContract.probability: Use the product of conditional draw probabilities for a complete path. For multiple routes to the same resolved identity, aggregate route probabilities explicitly. Multi-animal draws update the eligible pool without replacement and freeze odds before each draw.
mechanicsContract.weightPolicy: User-confirmed equal base weights (1 per eligible option) unless the user specified a distribution; declared eligibility and conditional modifiers are applied before normalization.
mechanicsContract.reactionPolicy: Family, origin, subtype, and event spins each retain their own reaction beat.
mechanicsContract.returnPolicy: Finish the selected identity's selectors/events, then run main archetype. Additional ancestry does not automatically reopen active family events. Shared subtree re-entry requires an explicit bounded call and consumed-event keys.
mechanicsContract.referenceEvents: The original Skeleton -> Bone Lineage -> Vampire -> Vampire Origins -> Goblin sequence remains a reference. Its adaptation into this grouped tree is not yet executable.

mechanicsContract.effectPolicy: influenceDraft/eventDraft fields remain proposals. Explicit Elf grants, numeric +1 Strength, Sea Elf 60/40, and declared subtype wheel routing are user-confirmed. Full simulation still requires complete balance, guards, scales and all reachable conditional influence profiles. Dwarf/Gnome routing, unique armor slots, named stat bonuses, and technology-as-weapon grants are user-defined. Armor count uses the disclosed 5:4:3:2:1 typo interpretation; uniform eligible armor-piece weights are now user-confirmed. All ten Mythical Beast local event profiles are explicitly user-defined in mythical-beast-events-design.json; their fixed grants/numeric modifiers apply independently from pending source influenceDraft fields.
mechanicsContract.selectorPolicy: Followup/resolvePlan runs in declared order. Explicit Hybrid/host/base/origin identity calls reuse canonical race-family and shared history; they do not restart the episode. Restore saved nested caller before later root or main stage.
mechanicsContract.singleOutcomePolicy: A fixed known identity is recorded and revealed without manufacturing a random spin. Every actual spin retains its own result/reaction. Exception: Dwarf armor awards explicitly require N actual piece spins, including a final 100%-probability spin when only one unique piece remains. Lich maximum-Durability realization also preserves the scheduled normal Durability spin at 100% rather than manufacturing a post-roll replacement; this realization remains a design interpretation.
mechanicsContract.narrativeContext: Race, subtype, and approved trait facts accumulate in the per-character context stack; use an as-of-spin view and keep mechanics authoritative. See framework/spec.json reactionContract.contextStack.
mechanicsContract.earlyGrantPolicy: Retain all race/event-granted powers/weapons; defer mastery to normal stages; None clears no earlier grant. Universal thematic powers resolve in universal-power-wheels-design.json; fixed Elf grants remain in elf-events-design.json.

sizePhase.phase: After Backstory and all immediate events, before Strength and the other four main stats.
sizePhase.invocations: Every character gets exactly one main Size spin. Raksasa replaces its ordinary Size variant with the eight giant milestones; it does not add a second mandatory Size spin.
sizePhase.meaning: A declared characteristic body dimension: humanoid height, elongated body length, or spherical diameter. Exclude wingspan unless the profile explicitly selects it. Celestial labels compare that linear dimension with the reference diameter.

normal.interpretation: The requested 0.5-to-2 range is subdivided into twelve equal steps/positions. A literal increment of 0.5 would yield only four sections.
normal.coordinate: linear multiplier relative to reference A
normal.parameterStatus: Broad width sigma=0.5 is a proposed tuning default; normal shape and broad width are requested.
normal.normalization: Discrete Gaussian-derived weights at the twelve support points; this is a bounded discrete wheel, not an unbounded continuous normal draw.
normal.expectedValueNote: The asymmetric support [0.5,2] means the resulting discrete expected multiplier is not exactly 1, even though the Gaussian center is 1.

giant.coordinate: User-named milestones across orders of magnitude; magnitude spacing does not assign odds
giant.parameterStatus: User-confirmed equal probability default; previous assistant-proposed log-Gaussian odds retired.
giant.spacing: Keep all eight user-specified milestones, including Planet Size and Sun Size.

sizePhase.profileResolution: Declared selected form/reference profile -> explicit generic species profile -> explicitly declared composition/host-size rule. Giant override wins when activated. Missing references are configuration gaps, never silent Human averages.
sizePhase.averageAuthority: Record the selected source and version. A stated mean may be used directly; a midpoint/rounded anchor from a lore range is a labeled game estimate, not a measured population mean.
sizePhase.baselineFreeze: Freeze profile, reference value, metric, multipliers/giant variant, source version, and exact odds before the Size draw. Later effects do not alter a committed Size result.
sizePhase.stats: Size is stored separately from base stats. It can declare later stat odds, equipment compatibility, and weakness effects; no automatic flat stat increase, unlimited mass scaling, or canonical power package.
sizePhase.lateChange: An explicitly approved later size change records its own effect/context and checks the same cosmic threshold without rerolling earlier Size or stat results.

universalElement.starterStatus: four existing familiar element candidates proposed; base weights equal

raceNoRepeat.status: User-confirmed global no-repeat history, including every nested family in the first Hybrid chain before its second draw.
raceNoRepeat.scope: Every character-identity race draw: main, Hybrid roots, Symbiote host, Raksasa base, Skeleton/Zombie origin, Mutant mutation root and every nested mutation identity draw.
raceNoRepeat.key: Canonical selectionFamilyId / option.familyId; enforce at the level selected by the race-family wheel.
raceNoRepeat.state: raceSelectionHistory[] and usedRaceFamilyIds[] shared by the whole character across all origin/parent branches.
raceNoRepeat.initial: The first main race result is committed to history before its subtype or other race events run. Selecting Skeleton/Zombie therefore already marks Lelembut used.
raceNoRepeat.beforeDraw: Intersect existing caller eligibility with familyId not in usedRaceFamilyIds. Disable all used sections before drawing; do not sample them then reroll.
raceNoRepeat.weights: Use user-specified weights where present, otherwise base weight 1. Apply approved modifiers and normalize over eligible positive weights. All previously selected race families have probability zero; exclusion dominates modifiers.
raceNoRepeat.commit: Atomically append invocation/role/family/component provenance and add the selected family to usedRaceFamilyIds before dispatching any child race events. Nested descendants use the same character history, never a copied/reset per-component set.
raceNoRepeat.resume: A resumed committed invocation reuses its result. It does not apply the exclusion to itself and reroll; history and consumed-event keys restore atomically.
raceNoRepeat.bounded: Each new identity-family result strictly enlarges the used set. At most the number of unique eligible catalog families can commit (19 in the current main pool), so race-family cycles cannot repeat indefinitely.
raceNoRepeat.emptyPool: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
raceNoRepeat.subtypes: Selecting a subtype/form is resolving the already-selected family, not selecting that family again. Known lore ancestry is not added to history unless it was actually selected by an identity race wheel.
raceNoRepeat.referenceBoundary: Vampire prey is a reference to a target, not a character race acquisition; it keeps its existing separate reference contract and does not consume personal race history.
raceNoRepeat.archetypeBoundary: Initial eligibility is evaluated once after the complete initial Race tree. Mutant may subsequently acquire a new race during its Archetype event using the same global history. Preserve the frozen pre-mutation gate/result; mutation children restore the saved Mutant caller and never re-enter the gate. Initial Raksasa skips; mutation-acquired Raksasa keeps giant Size but does not revoke the selected Mutant. Older committed journals retain their original policy.
raceNoRepeat.example: Hybrid → Symbiote → Raksasa → Abyssal Axiom commits hybrid/symbiote/raksasa/demon. The second Hybrid draw excludes all four (plus any earlier history), leaving 15 of 19 if all other options are eligible.

mythicalBeastEvents.profileAuthority: Dragon imports dragon-events-design.json. Seven other Imported types use importedEventProfiles here. Execute one selected canonical profile once; inline/import pointers are references, not additional effects.
mythicalBeastEvents.selectorOrder: Commit the actual local type and its fixed effects/constraints, react, then resolve its single declared Element child if Naga, react to that result, and restore saved continuation.
mythicalBeastEvents.importedSelectorOrder: Actual Imported type -> its approved canonical profile -> commit fixed identity/grants/modifiers and reaction -> only Dragon runs its form/Element children -> exact saved caller.

powerMastery.lateGrant: A power granted after a shared result commits inherits the same base/effective mastery and active bonuses immediately, without a new spin or mastery reaction.
powerMastery.emptyGate: If no powers are owned and no shared result exists, skip the scheduled mastery stage with a recorded reason. No phantom power or mastery spin.

elementalEvents.profileAuthority: The profile here is canonical. Race branch and specification pointers are references/mirrors, not extra independent invocations.

symbioteEvents.profileAuthority: Profiles and the Takeover wheel here are canonical. Race branch/import references point here and execute one profile once, never both mirrors as independent invocations.

heavenlyPrincipleEvents.profileAuthority: Profiles here are canonical. Inline race outcomes are mirrors/pointers and must not execute a second copy.

abyssalAxiomEvents.profileAuthority: Profiles and wheels here are canonical. Inline race mirrors/imports do not register or dispatch duplicate events.

hybridEvents.profileAuthority: Canonical Hybrid contract/sequence only; mirrors do not execute twice.

animeEvents.profileAuthority: These profiles/wheels are canonical; race design imports are references, never second registrations or duplicate invocations.

machineEvents.status: Seven Machine types; Transformer Vehicle Shifting. Nanobot directly Shapeshifting; AI directly Digital Being/+2 Intelligence, Cyborg one weapon/+1 Intelligence, Android one power. Four new twelve-entry catalogs remain; Household twenty short-name weak linked powers. Body/Size and detailed limits pending.
flow: commit actual Machine family to shared race history
one actual machine-type spin/reaction once its roster is approved
restore exact saved caller; main Archetype only after outer race tree completes
machineEvents.catalogReadiness: Future execution requires a nonempty approved type roster and an explicit approved profile per type, including an explicit no-event profile if desired. Missing profiles are configuration errors, never silent event skips or permission to execute proposals.
machineEvents.history: Machine uses canonical family ID machine. Main/Hybrid/host/base/origin identity draws share usedRaceFamilyIds. Commit before type events, exclude it from every later identity draw, and restore committed history on replay without redispatch.
machineEvents.boundaries: Golem remains separate. Anime MC Sci-fi Cyborg keeps its existing two Tech Weapon spins; Pilot keeps the existing rideable vehicle event. Selecting proposed Machine Cyborg/Mecha does not import those packages. No automatic mapping of archived video Cyborg into Machine.
machineEvents.size: One global Size stage; Machine body reference/metric and subtype measurements remain pending. Never default to Human or add a second Size spin. Existing Raksasa giant binding still applies when actually selected.
machineEvents.effects: AI grants Digital Being plus +2 numeric Intelligence once per type source, no additional AI type spin. Cyborg +1 numeric Intelligence once plus exactly one weapon; Android exactly one owned power. Mecha only chosen body-model identity. Transformer selects one vehicle form and receives its linked Vehicle Shifting power, without another power selector. Nanobot directly grants one Shapeshifting power, without subtype/model/acquisition spin. Household now grants one extremely weak mundane-function power linked to its actual item, with no additional acquisition spin.
machineEvents.mastery: Any later approved powers use the one common Power Mastery, with existing source-scoped exceptions. Weapons retain per-weapon mastery/compatible Master+ Enchant; Machine alone adds no mastery modifier.
machineEvents.context: Stack only actual family/type/event commits and their provenance. Narration does not generate effects or future stat/type facts.
machineEvents.influence: Future conditional probability/eligibility profiles remain pending. Type identity alone does not invent multipliers, restrictions or guaranteed stats.
machineEvents.idempotence: One subtype invocation per actual Machine source component, linked to parent spin/component/root slot and exact continuation. Resume restores actual committed results without new draws or duplicated effects.

funnyResultPolicy.status: Authored explicit funny-result tags within user-delegated zonk suggestions plus preserved Household tags; use existing already-active Shrek hook.
funnyResultPolicy.parentTags: Machine family and seven primary type outcomes are not funny-result tagged. Each actual tagged child result triggers at most once, only if Shrek was already active; fixed grants, captions and context updates are not spins. Fixed Nanobot Shapeshifting grant creates no additional trigger. Fixed Vehicle Shifting grant creates no additional trigger.
funnyResultPolicy.activeGuard: Shrek Power was already active before this actual committed item spin.
funnyResultPolicy.effect: Reuse existing +1 numeric point to each of the five main stats once per qualifying committed spin, through its source ledger and existing caps. No active Shrek means no numeric comedy bonus.
funnyResultPolicy.idempotence: Use existing hookId/run/source/actual spin invocation keys. Replay/rerender/caption edits do not add triggers; no retroactive bonus if Shrek arrives later.
funnyResultPolicy.narration: Do not turn a funny caption into a mechanics tag on other outcomes or claim a stat increase absent a committed hook effect.

typeDistinctness.status: Seven current Machine branches retained; primary identity is separate from follow-up catalog result.
typeDistinctness.axis: Primary character identity and body/representation concept. One actual subtype result dispatches one explicit profile; secondary lore/design tags never invoke another Machine type event.

interpretations.cyborg: Tubuh biologis yang dimodifikasi dengan komponen mesin; organisme asal dan upgrade belum ditentukan.
interpretations.mecha: Unit mesin tempur dengan tema kokpit/pilot atau kendali; karakter tetap unit Machine, bukan otomatis pilot atau kendaraan milik karakter lain.
interpretations.transformer: Transformer; mode kendaraan dipilih lewat spin, lalu memperoleh Vehicle Shifting.
interpretations.nanobot: Nanobot directly receives Shapeshifting; no colony-model selection.

typeDistinctness.ai: Digital Being is explicitly granted with Intelligence +2. No extra AI subtype selector; body/digital manifestation, substrate and global Size metric remain pending. AI flavor on another actual type opens no AI event.
typeDistinctness.household: Selected household utility body grants its one explicitly linked extremely weak appliance-function power, no extra selector. Robot Vacuum remains Household and triggers no AI/Android/Nanobot event.
typeDistinctness.overlap: Choose the primary subtype from the actual result and record optional secondary visual themes without additional spins, automatic equipment/powers or implied biological ancestry.
typeDistinctness.retired: Robot is an umbrella suggestion and Automaton a possible visual/mechanical style; neither remains an independent current subtype option.
typeDistinctness.noSizeInference: Body references and actual measurements for Mecha/colony/digital forms remain pending. No automatic Raksasa/zero Size, extra global Size draw, Human fallback, pilot, crew or canonical vehicle dimensions. Source biological-machine motifs do not dispatch another race.

householdWeakPower.status: User explicitly extremely weak/laughing stock and one related power after item.
householdWeakPower.scope: Only ordinary appliance function, confined to its normal household use/capacity; no combat/elemental powers, automatic equipment/stat/mastery grant or scaling from Size.
householdWeakPower.mastery: Every weak grant is an owned power and uses the one common Power Mastery. Better mastery controls the same mundane function, without automatically upgrading its scope/output to a superpower.
householdWeakPower.stats: No numerical stat penalty, maximum-stat constraint or removal of another source reward was requested; do not invent those from weak flavor. Other actual stats, weapons, powers and active Shrek effects retain their source rules.
householdWeakPower.narration: Short power names/punchlines only, no explanatory addendum or godlike/legendary/strong framing.
householdWeakPower.timing: Actual item commits → exactly one linked power source grant commits → one applicable existing Shrek hook for that item spin → context/reaction → saved return. Fixed grant is not another spin.

sharedMachineWheels.policy: One definition per wheel and per granted power/weapon. Future approved callers import same IDs/base pools and true source provenance; no caller clones. Power-android is an additional canonical theme, separate from the unchanged six core thematic pools.

machineEvents.inventory: Android Power, AI Digital Being, Nanobot Shapeshifting, Transformer Vehicle Shifting and each explicit Appliance weak power count as owned powers and survive main None, using one shared Power Mastery. Cyborg grants one owned built-in weapon that survives main None and receives normal per-instance Weapon Mastery and compatible Master+ Enchant. AI/Cyborg Intelligence modifiers are numeric points, once per committed source, not tier jumps.
machineEvents.zonkPolicy: Zonk is a comedy/utility metadata label. No automatic None, skipped reward, numeric penalty, rarity change, weakness or reroll. Four zonk outcomes of each new twelve-entry draft have tags zonk/funny-result; all original Household items keep their existing funny-result tags. Weak power/weapon still counts for normal inventory/mastery.

jokePresentation.display: Use short power names/punchlines. Blender: Ngejus. Air Fryer: Goreng Tanpa Minyak. Do not explain the joke or add a stronger interpretation.
jokePresentation.internal: Retain mechanical scope, provenance and actual source effects for autonomous resolution; do not read those internal bounds as an explanatory caption.

vehicleShifting.timing: Mode commit → linked grant/binding → at most one already-active Shrek hook for the actual tagged mode spin → result context/reaction → saved caller.
vehicleShifting.idempotence: One fixed grant per actual Transformer type source. Retry restores the mode and grant; no duplicate power, mastery or hook. More mode bindings require later explicit authorization.
vehicleShifting.mastery: Retain after main None; use the one common Power Mastery. No power Enchant.
vehicleShifting.scope: Only the actual selected vehicle form; no separate owned vehicle, crew, built-in weapons, stat bonuses, automatic Flight power, extra Size or unlimited forms.
vehicleShifting.runtimeReadiness: Body/Size reference and detailed transformation limits remain pending.

mutantRaceMutation.returnPolicy: After every mandatory immediate mutation child returns and reacts, complete Mutant once and restore Backstory. Keep deferred tickets for their normal stages.
mutantRaceMutation.gatePolicy: Archetype eligibility/result was already committed against the completed pre-mutation Race tree. Reuse that frozen decision; do not re-enter the gate, redraw Archetype, undo Mutant or retroactively skip it when mutation acquires a strong/always-skip race. Raksasa acquired during mutation still binds giant Size, but cannot erase a previously selected Archetype. New identity children return to the saved event, not the top-level Race->Archetype transition.

referencePolicy.firstVideoUsage: Historical extraction only; user selects second video as current reference.

contract.phase: After Backstory and all immediate events, before Strength and the other four main stats.
contract.invocations: Every character gets exactly one main Size spin. Raksasa replaces its ordinary Size variant with the eight giant milestones; it does not add a second mandatory Size spin.
contract.unit: Integer display values in a profile-wide mm/cm/m/km unit; canonical meters and safe integer millimeters.
contract.meaning: A declared characteristic body dimension: humanoid height, elongated body length, or spherical diameter. Exclude wingspan unless the profile explicitly selects it. Celestial labels compare that linear dimension with the reference diameter.

normal.rangeAuthority: Versioned selected race/subrace/form interval and applicable Archetype, sourced or explicitly user-authorized assumption; no universal Human or 0.5–2x fallback.
normal.autoSpacing: Authored default: exponential when max/min >= 10; otherwise linear. Threshold editable per profile.
normal.rounding: Whole display-unit values; optional integer quantum, endpoints preserved, clamp within bounds.
normal.duplicatePolicy: Merge equal rounded values and sum broad-normal sample mass. Never show duplicate sectors; narrow ranges may have fewer than 12 outcomes.
normal.weighting: Broad-normal component priors, then versioned conditional Bayesian evidence and joint interactions; display spacing is independent of posterior odds.
normal.centerDefault: Midpoint fallback only; calibrated profiles explicitly supply a source-derived mean/typical/estimated center. Not necessarily the truncated wheel mean.
normal.sigmaDefault: Half coordinate span fallback; calibrated lore intervals use half their source span. Broad-width shape is authored, never an empirical sigma claim.
normal.equalMode: Explicit equal profile or active Equalizer uses one weight per unique eligible sector.
normal.modifiers: Explicit model likelihoods/mixture influences/factors before freeze, dependency grouping; Equalizer makes displayed hard-eligible outcomes uniform.

giant.coordinate: User-named milestones across orders of magnitude; magnitude spacing does not assign odds
giant.parameterStatus: User-confirmed equal probability default; previous assistant-proposed log-Gaussian odds retired.
giant.weightFormula: Default prior w_i=1,p_i=1/8; only explicit giant-scoped likelihoods/factors modify these before freeze.
giant.spacing: Keep all eight user-specified milestones, including Planet Size and Sun Size.

contract.profileResolution: Raksasa support override -> explicit all-source body profile -> one most-specific normal-form prior per completed owner identity -> same-metric mixture or declared principal-extent projection -> conditional likelihoods -> readable whole-number wheel.
contract.averageAuthority: Record the selected source and version. A stated mean may be used directly; a midpoint/rounded anchor from a lore range is a labeled game estimate, not a measured population mean.
contract.baselineFreeze: Save context sources, all component priors, model/version/parameters, applied/skipped rules, full posterior, display projection and final odds before one external draw; no reroll or model update on replay.
contract.stats: Size has no flat stat bonus. The stat-odds/0.1.0 model uses declared bounded logarithmic physical-size likelihoods, with separate responses per stat and no avatar mass. Equipment/weakness rules remain separate.
contract.lateChange: An explicitly approved later size change records its own effect/context and checks the same cosmic threshold without rerolling earlier Size or stat results.
contract.identityScope: Only committed owner identities: exclude Slayer prey, Warlord troops, Vampire victims, Disciple mentors, companions, mounts and equipped external mechs.
contract.archetypeRange: Archetype may select a declared prior range or a conditional likelihood/interaction. Evidence already encoded in a prior is skipped unless an explicit joint interaction is declared.

transformationSize.authority: User explicitly excludes Size for transformations on 2026-10-10.
transformationSize.effect: Retain normal-form Size and existing transformation powers/bindings; no extra Size input, wheel or stat-odds recomputation for alternate forms.

policy.priority: Explicit user support ranges first, named form-specific reference next, chosen versioned species reference next; unknown forms require configuration.
policy.priors: Source mean/typical value when provided; otherwise explicitly estimated interval midpoint. A curated named-character sample is editorial, not a measured population.
policy.width: Broad-normal shape and widths are game-design policy, not empirical probabilities derived from wiki pages.
policy.crossovers: Equal mixture weights and conditional strengths remain explicit design assumptions; do not invent confidence percentages or self-train on generated spins.
policy.negativeEvidence: Failure to find a numeric rule does not prove impossibility; unsupported numeric interactions stay neutral until an explicit calibration is supplied.
policy.replay: Only future plans use new values. Frozen numeric support/odds/models and historical journals retain their saved versions.
policy.assumptions: User explicitly authorizes reasonable size assumptions for the remaining race/subrace profiles. Store support/center/body-form/metric and assumption label; no additional approval needed for these normal-form defaults.
policy.crossMetricComposition: Explicit per-profile principal-dimension projection at scale1 to characteristic-dimension, used only for mixed-metric composition. This compares declared body extents for the fantasy design, not physical equality of measurements. Missing/mismatched projection still requires an explicit body profile.
policy.manifestations: AI/Ghost/Elemental/Primordial abstract profiles measure rendered avatar/swarm envelope; no physical mass, damage, actual storm, planet or universe assigned from display size.

compositionMetricPolicy.authority: User permits authored Size assumptions for remaining identities and compositions. Only profiles explicitly declaring their source metric and scale1 may participate.
compositionMetricPolicy.interpretation: Mixture uncertainty about dominant normal-form principal dimension; not multiplying simultaneous body measurements or asserting a real-world height/length equivalence.

probabilisticContract.formula: P(size|context) ∝ P_prior(size)^priorStrength × product(P(context_group|size)^effectiveStrength) × explicit factors; normalize on hard-eligible support.
probabilisticContract.modelClass: Discrete conditional Bayesian/tempered likelihood model; strength1 is the declared ordinary Bayesian update. Lore likelihood parameters are authored, not validated probabilities of real-world observations.
probabilisticContract.raceComposition: One specific prior per owned body identity; mixture over the same metric or explicit per-profile principal-extent projection for mixed metrics. Explicit all-source body profile wins; no hidden Human fallback.
probabilisticContract.mixtureFormula: P_prior(size) = sum(normalizedRaceInfluence_j * P_j(size)); union of whole-number supports, no multiplying contradictory absolute-body densities.
probabilisticContract.dependencies: Subtype already encoded in selected prior is not treated as an independent observation again. One most-specific rule per dependency group; equal-specificity ties need configuration. Explicit interaction=true is a conditional joint correction, not a duplicate independent clue.
probabilisticContract.evidenceScope: Canonical committed owner family/results/Archetype IDs only. External troops/prey/mentors/equipment and future uncommitted spins are not context evidence.
probabilisticContract.display: Condition the full finite candidate distribution first, then approximate at most12 readable whole-number sectors by posterior quantiles/nearest bins. Sum assigned mass; preserve full posterior and projection mapping. Single12-point profile remains unchanged.
probabilisticContract.equalizer: Override final displayed hard-eligible sectors to uniform; suppress soft lore bias, preserve physical support/guards.
probabilisticContract.numerics: Log-space likelihood normalization avoids product underflow; reject contradictory all-zero likelihood unless Equalizer suppresses soft bias.
probabilisticContract.giant: Raksasa fixes abnormal support of eight milestones. Default prior1/8; only explicitly scoped giant evidence/factors can change odds. Initial lore rules are normal-only.
probabilisticContract.calibration: Selected lore centers and explicit user-authorized normal-form intervals for complete current identity coverage. Broad widths, mixture/conditional strengths and principal-extent projection remain authored; not empirical population probabilities.

acceptedRequirements: Start with a selected comment or direct spin request
Race, archetype, and backstory each have result-specific event wheels
Main stats are strength, speed, durability, intelligence, and fight
Weapon is followed by weapon mastery; master or higher unlocks enchantment
Power follows the weapon pattern without enchantment
Then weakness, apex force, conditional stat boost, and title with possible hidden events
Generate the character image from resolved results, then display final stats
Every spin before main stats affects the probability distribution of later relevant wheels
Every spin, including event wheels, receives narrator commentary, meme video, and text
Mechanics first; detailed names and cultural content later
Use familiar mixed Indonesian/English labels rather than strict Indonesian translations
Allow Siluman to roll multiple animal types
Expand mythical beasts using researched references

Helmet, Body Armor, and Leggings each add +1 Durability; Gloves add +1 Fight; Boots add +1 Speed, recorded as numeric-point modifiers under the existing point convention.

hybridComposition.eligibleFamilyPolicy: Use the complete canonical main race pool, including Reinkarnasi Pahlawan Legendaris, Anime and Heavenly Principle. Filter all previously selected families; Hybrid is already used when its event starts, so it cannot select itself.
hybridComposition.componentResolution: Spin component 1, commit its family/history before dispatch, and finish every immediate event and nested race chain. Register later-stage tickets without advancing main stages. Only then spin component 2 using the accumulated history and run its events the same way.
hybridComposition.distinctnessPolicy: Before every identity-family draw disable ALL previously committed families across both roots and every nested host/origin, not just the first root or final leaf. Filter before draw, never reroll forbidden results.
hybridComposition.poolExhaustion: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
hybridComposition.eventOrder: Hybrid result/reaction → component 1 result/reaction and complete immediate nested chain → component 2 result/reaction and complete immediate chain → record completion → saved caller. No fusion stability or dominance wheel.
hybridComposition.eventScope: Only an actual explicit Hybrid family selection opens this two-root sequence; lore Half-Ghoul/Half-Demon/Demigod or reference ancestry does not dispatch it automatically.
hybridComposition.journalPolicy: Two stable root slots 1/2, with separately linked host/origin descendants. Every invocation carries component/parent/root-slot and return continuation. History is shared globally.
hybridComposition.effectsPolicy: Retain every explicitly approved grant, modifier, guarantee and deferred ticket from both actual chains. Apply each source once under source-once additive stacking with no numeric floor/cap. No blanket stat addition, halving, automatic power package, suppression or extra mastery spin.
hybridComposition.anatomyPolicy: Store both root identities and nested modifiers in one body brief. Anatomical conflict/body-reference policy remains pending; do not invent stability/dominance results or discard committed race rewards.
hybridComposition.returnTo: saved caller; archetype for ordinary main race-stage chain
hybridComposition.size: One global Size: current normal-form profiles cover all completed owner identity routes. Use adjustable same-metric mixture or explicit principal-extent projection for mixed metrics; an explicit all-source frozen body range wins. Raksasa retains eight milestones. AI artwork prose is not a probability parameter or physical mass.
hybridComposition.mastery: All owned powers share the existing single character mastery and scoped Authority exception. Weapons keep their normal per-weapon mastery/Enchant.
hybridComposition.context: Append actual roots, nested families, grants, modifiers and upcoming steps with provenance. Future second race and final stats remain unknown until committed.
hybridComposition.idempotence: Keys include root slot and nested component/step. Resume restores a committed result and continues its unfinished children, never applies history to reroll it or executes an event twice.
hybridComposition.budgets: Validate configured event budgets can support required chains. Current numerical limits are proposed; on required overflow fail configuration, never truncate the two-root sequence.
